name: 2-(2-Hydroxypropoxy)-1-propanol
description: 2-(2-Hydroxypropoxy)-1-propanol (CAS 106-62-7 ), commonly known as dipropylene glycol, is a diol solvent and humectant used across cleaning, coatings, and personal care manufacturing. Its low volatility and miscibility with water and organic solvents make it a practical carrier and coupling agent in formulated products. In home care and industrial cleaning, it functions as a coupling solvent. This material keeps surfactant-based formulations stable and improves soil removal in hard-surface cleaners. Coatings and adhesives manufacturers use it as a coalescing aid and plasticizing solvent. It helps to improve film formation and flexibility in waterborne systems. Personal care formulators incorporate it as a humectant and solvent carrier in lotions, serums, and fragrance bases. It is ideal for applications where controlled moisture retention is required. In polymer processing, it acts as a reactive intermediate or plasticizer in polyurethane and polyester resin systems. The product is supplied as a clear, low-viscosity liquid in drum, IBC, and bulk tanker quantities. Standard commercial grades include industrial and fragrance-grade specifications for various uses. Fragrance grade meets purity requirements set by IFRA and major flavor and fragrance buyers.
